# watchpoint_alert_profile (Resource)

An alert profile controlling notification routing, cooldown, dedup behaviour and a set of notification channels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_alert_profile" "example" {
  name              = "DevOps Team"
  cooldown_minutes  = 15
  alert_on_recovery = true

  channels = [
    {
      type            = "Email"
      email_addresses = "oncall@example.com,team@example.com"
    },
    {
      type              = "Slack"
      slack_webhook_url = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/XXX"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable profile name.

### Optional

- `alert_on_recovery` (Boolean) Send a notification when a monitor recovers. Defaults to `true`.
- `channels` (Attributes List) Notification channels attached to this profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `consecutive_failures` (Number) Consecutive failing checks required before alerting. Defaults to `1`.
- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minutes to suppress repeat alerts after firing. Defaults to `5`.
- `deduplicate_across_regions` (Boolean) Collapse a multi-region failure into a single alert. Defaults to `true`.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `escalation_policy_id` (String) Optional escalation policy walked when alerts stay unacknowledged.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default alert profile. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `owner_group_id` (String) User group (`watchpoint_user_group`) that owns this profile. A filter label only; it grants no access. The API rejects a group that does not exist in the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Alert profile ID.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global, system-managed profile (read-only).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Required:

- `type` (String) Channel type. One of `Email`, `Webhook`, `Slack`, `PagerDuty`, `Discord`, `Teams`, `OpsGenie`, `Zoom`, `Ticketing`, `Telegram`, `GoogleChat`, `Mattermost`, `Pushover`, `Webex`.

Optional:

- `bot_recipient` (String) Telegram chat id, or Pushover user/group key.
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Bot or application token for `Telegram` and `Pushover` channels. Write-only on the API, so the configured value is kept in state and sent on every save. A `{{vault.KEY}}` reference is accepted.
- `chat_webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Incoming-webhook URL for `GoogleChat`, `Mattermost` and `Webex` channels. It carries a token, so it is sensitive.
- `discord_webhook_url` (String) Discord webhook URL (Discord channels).
- `email_addresses` (String) Comma-separated recipient email addresses (Email channels).
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Optional channel display name.
- `opsgenie_api_key` (String, Sensitive) OpsGenie API key (OpsGenie channels).
- `opsgenie_api_url` (String) OpsGenie API base URL (region-specific).
- `opsgenie_auto_resolve` (Boolean) Auto-close the OpsGenie alert on recovery. Defaults to `true`.
- `opsgenie_priority_map` (String) JSON map of Watchpoint severities to OpsGenie priorities.
- `opsgenie_responders` (String) JSON-encoded OpsGenie responders.
- `pagerduty_auto_resolve` (Boolean) Auto-resolve the PagerDuty incident on recovery. Defaults to `true`.
- `pagerduty_routing_key` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty Events API routing key (PagerDuty channels).
- `pagerduty_severity_map` (String) JSON map of Watchpoint severities to PagerDuty severities.
- `pushover_priority` (Number) Pushover priority, `-2` to `2`. Recovery messages never go above normal priority.
- `slack_signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Slack app signing secret that verifies interactive button clicks (acknowledge/resolve from Slack). Write-only on the API, so the configured value is kept in state and sent on every save.
- `slack_webhook_url` (String) Slack incoming-webhook URL (Slack channels).
- `teams_webhook_url` (String) Microsoft Teams webhook URL (Teams channels).
- `ticket_api_token` (String, Sensitive) Tracker API token. A `{{vault.KEY}}` reference is accepted.
- `ticket_auto_close` (Boolean) Close the issue when the alert recovers. Defaults to `true`.
- `ticket_base_url` (String) Tracker base URL. For `zendesk` a bare subdomain is accepted; `github` ignores it.
- `ticket_close_transition` (String) Transition or status applied on recovery (for `zendesk`, defaults to `solved`).
- `ticket_issue_type` (String) Issue type. For `github` it is applied as labels.
- `ticket_project_key` (String) Project or queue the issue is opened in. For `github` this is `owner/repo`.
- `ticket_provider` (String) Issue tracker for `Ticketing` channels: `jira`, `servicenow`, `linear`, `github` or `zendesk`. Requires the `incident_management` feature.
- `ticket_user_email` (String) Account email used with the token (Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk).
- `webhook_headers` (String) JSON-encoded headers sent with the webhook.
- `webhook_method` (String) HTTP method used for the webhook.
- `webhook_payload_template` (String) Custom payload template rendered for the webhook.
- `webhook_template_key` (String) Key of a built-in payload template to use.
- `webhook_url` (String) Generic webhook URL (Webhook channels).
- `zoom_webhook_url` (String) Zoom webhook URL (Zoom channels).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_alert_profile.example ap_001
```
